mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.user_id, e.name, e.age, e.gender, e.birthday, e.id_card, e.address, e.room_id, r.room_number, r.room_type, e.emergency_contact, e.emergency_phone, e.medical_history, e.allergy_history, e.create_time, e.update_time FROM elderly_info e LEFT JOIN room r ON e.room_id = r.id WHERE e.id = #{elderlyId} AND e.deleted = 0
